changes.title: Cold War memories stir Rubio in Iceland as he champions diplomacy and downplays differences
changes.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Tuesday sought to reassure NATO ally Iceland that President Donald Trump's administration has no designs on the island but shares its deep concerns about Arctic security as tensions between the United States and Russia rise in the high north and elsewhere.

changes.title: NATO jets down drone in Lithuanian airspace
changes.summary: The incident came less than a day after NATO leaders pledged that strikes close to the alliance's territory would drive the trans-Atlantic organization to increase support for Kyiv. (Image credit: AP Photo).

changes.title: News Wrap: Kennedy Center warns of 'fiscal collapse' without Trump's name on building
changes.summary: In our news wrap Monday, officials at the Kennedy Center are warning of "certain fiscal collapse" unless President Trump's name is added to the exterior of the building, several state election officials tell the News Hour they are bracing for uncertainty over mail-in ballots ahead of the midterms and NATO Secretary-Gen.

changes.title: Lithuania prepares for war, reinforcing its border against Russian tanks
changes.summary: On the edge of NATO territory in the Baltics, there is growing concern about the threat Russia poses. Aaron MacLean visited the capital of Lithuania to see how they're preparing.

changes.title: Poland says it thwarted Russian plot to kill an American citizen in a NATO country
changes.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said it marks the first time Russia sought to attack an American citizen in another NATO country.

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: Voters in a half a dozen states went to the polls Tuesday, report suggests President Trump switch aircraft due to threat as he was leaving NATO, Iraq's leader wants to disarm Iran-backed militias.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: President Trump boarded Air Force One last month as usual. But the Washington Post reports he was smuggled off the plane in a catering truck and flew on an entirely different aircraft due to a threat.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: The United States picked up multiple streams of information, including one potential threat that involved a shoulder-fired missile.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: President Trump secretly left Turkey last month following a NATO summit on a different plane than Air Force One even though many others were still allowed to board. Mr. Trump on Tuesday made his first public comments about the secret switch. Nancy Cordes reports.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: President Trump hid in an airport catering container and was taken to a military jet for a secret flight out of country after the NATO summit last month.
